clauses.title: The issue status block marks publication as not applicable
requires: findings: <internal finding id: disposition, one per line>

clauses.title: The driver renders the PR status block with the observation, the findings and the operator actions
The driver resumes from its run directory after recomputing every fingerprint; a pasted block is not read
requires: The packaged review-only driver resumes only a `WAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` stop, from its own run directory and after recomputing every fingerprint; every other stop is followed by a fresh run, and a pasted block is not read

clauses.title: The review-only driver resumes only a WAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW stop and binds the mode
requires: if (s.state !== 'WAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW') die(`a ${s.state} run is not resumable; start a fresh run`);
